meta.note: Single light theme by decision (2026-09-27): black on white, like a book. Roles and rules: docs/design/ui_design.md (Color); brand hexes: docs/design/product-brandbook.md §12. Tokens marked 'Proposed' are additions not yet in code.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground behind all regions; also palette input ground.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Navigator, document, Inspector and popups. Equal to bg: regions are separated by a hairline, never by fill.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Proposed. Chrome ground: AppBar, DocHeader and the collapsed navigator rail, so chrome reads apart from content without heavier borders.

tokens.name: fg
tokens.usage: All primary text, on bg, surface, surface-2, hover and selected. Brand Graphite (product-brandbook.md §12), the same hex as chrome-ink. 15.8:1 on white.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text (dates, counts, captions, kbd hints) on bg, surface and surface-2 (≥4.5:1). Not on selected (4.0:1): selected rows show dates in fg.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines between regions and around inputs and cards. Decorative only: it does not reach 3:1, so never the sole affordance of a control.

tokens.name: hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill on tree rows, menu items and icon buttons.

tokens.name: selected
tokens.usage: Selected tree row, current app in the switcher, active Inspector tab indicator ground.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Links, focus ring (2px solid, 2px offset), primary button fill, the Atlas mark, active tab underline.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill (5.2:1).

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Identity only: the Atlas mark, section eyebrows on the launcher, the signed-out cover headline. Brand Aubergine. Never links, buttons, focus, selection, status or data.

tokens.name: brand-highlight
tokens.usage: Identity only: the curved-underline motif, at most once per screen, on the launcher and the signed-out cover. Brand Coral. Never status: overdue and errors are danger.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive actions, broken-link chips, error toast border. Always paired with a word or ⚠ glyph.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Connected/saved status dots. 3.3:1 on white: marks and 24px+ text only, never body text.

tokens.name: warning-bg
tokens.usage: Banner ground for revision / conflict notices, text in fg.

tokens.name: warning-border
tokens.usage: Border of warning banners; the unsaved-changes dot.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim behind modals and overlaid panels (tablet/phone).

tokens.name: code-bg
tokens.usage: Inline code, file paths in the metadata popover, source-mode editor ground.

tokens.name: chrome-ink
tokens.usage: The AppBar ground: an ink frame above the white page.

tokens.name: on-chrome
tokens.usage: Text and icons on chrome-ink (14.6:1).

tokens.name: on-chrome-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on chrome-ink: breadcrumb, hints (7.2:1).

tokens.name: chrome-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for AppBar controls.

tokens.name: chrome-line
tokens.usage: Hairlines and field borders on chrome-ink.

tokens.name: icon-folder
tokens.usage: Folder icons (4.9:1 on white, 4.0:1 on selected).

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Markdown file icons.

tokens.name: icon-image
tokens.usage: Image file icons.

tokens.name: icon-data
tokens.usage: Data/config file icons (json, yaml, csv).

tokens.name: icon-code
tokens.usage: Code file icons.

tokens.name: icon-file
tokens.usage: Any other file.

tokens.name: icon-layer
tokens.usage: Map layer icons.

tokens.name: icon-task
tokens.usage: Planner task icons (a bar).

tokens.name: icon-summary
tokens.usage: Planner summary icons (a bracket).

tokens.name: icon-milestone
tokens.usage: Planner milestone icons (a diamond).

tokens.name: icon-hammock
tokens.usage: Planner hammock icons (a dashed bracket).

tokens.name: icon-subproject
tokens.usage: Planner subproject icons (a box in a box).

tokens.name: icon-bundle
tokens.usage: Workspace bundle icons (a page with pages behind it): a folder shown as one item.

tokens.name: hl-1
tokens.usage: Timeline highlight rule colour 1 (blue): chip border and dot over a 14% tint; text stays --fg.

tokens.name: hl-2
tokens.usage: Timeline highlight rule colour 2 (amber): chip border and dot over a 14% tint; text stays --fg.

tokens.name: hl-3
tokens.usage: Timeline highlight rule colour 3 (green): chip border and dot over a 14% tint; text stays --fg.

tokens.name: hl-4
tokens.usage: Timeline highlight rule colour 4 (magenta): chip border and dot over a 14% tint; text stays --fg.

tokens.name: hl-5
tokens.usage: Timeline highlight rule colour 5 (red): chip border and dot over a 14% tint; text stays --fg.

tokens.name: hl-6
tokens.usage: Timeline highlight rule colour 6 (teal): chip border and dot over a 14% tint; text stays --fg.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Counts, section captions, kbd hints. Existing size (style.css .atlas-caption).

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Proposed. Metadata chip, tree row trailing badges, Inspector field labels.

styles.name: ui
styles.usage: Proposed as the one chrome size: tree rows, menus, buttons, AppBar, DocHeader actions. Replaces the 12 / 12.5 / 13px mix.

styles.name: ui-strong
styles.usage: Proposed. Inspector tab labels, tree folder headings, AppBar document title.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: In −689 CY, Westmarch raises defensive walls.
styles.usage: Proposed. Rendered markdown and event text. Measure capped at 72ch.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Proposed. The document title inside DocHeader (one line, ellipsis). Replaces the 32px H1 that pushed content down.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, chip padding-y.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tree row padding-x, gaps between DocHeader actions.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Region padding-x (AppBar, DocHeader, Inspector).

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Document padding-x on narrow screens, card padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Document padding-x on wide screens, section gaps.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, kbd, tree row hover fill.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, menu items.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Popups, palette, cards, the Atlas mark. Absorbs the ad-hoc 7/10/12px radii in style.css.

size.note: Proposed layout metrics. Each is a CSS length consumed by the shell grid.

tokens.name: appbar-h
tokens.usage: AppBar height (ink frame).

tokens.name: docheader-h
tokens.usage: Proposed. DocHeader height (one line).

tokens.name: row-compact
tokens.usage: Proposed. Tree row height in compact density (default on pointer: fine).

tokens.name: row-default
tokens.usage: Proposed. Tree row height in comfortable density.

tokens.name: row-touch
tokens.usage: Tree row and button min height on pointer: coarse (existing rule).

tokens.name: rail-w
tokens.usage: Proposed. Collapsed navigator rail width.

tokens.name: panel-w
tokens.usage: Proposed default navigator width (today 260px, which wraps kb titles to two lines). Resizable 220–480; remembered.

tokens.name: inspector-w
tokens.usage: Proposed. Inspector width; resizable 300–480. Docked and open by default at ≥1600px.

tokens.name: handle-w
tokens.usage: The agent's edge handle: width of the tab flush to the document edge.

tokens.name: handle-h
tokens.usage: The agent's edge handle: height of the tab.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Proposed. Max width of document text (≈72 characters of body). Wide screens gain margin, never line length.

tokens.name: actionbar-h
tokens.usage: Mobile layer: ActionBar height on phones, excluding the bottom safe area (docs/design/mobile.md).

tokens.name: text-input-touch
tokens.usage: Mobile layer: minimum input font size under pointer: coarse (prevents iOS zoom on focus).

tokens.name: safe-top
tokens.usage: Mobile layer: device safe-area inset; non-zero only with viewport-fit=cover.

tokens.name: safe-right
tokens.usage: Mobile layer: device safe-area inset.

tokens.name: safe-bottom
tokens.usage: Mobile layer: device safe-area inset (home indicator); the ActionBar and Sheet footers add it.

tokens.name: safe-left
tokens.usage: Mobile layer: device safe-area inset.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Floating dock and task pill (existing value).

tokens.name: shadow-popup
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, command palette (existing value).

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Navigator or Inspector when overlaying content (existing value for the navigator; mirrored for Inspector).

zIndex.note: Existing values collected from packages/app-suite/src/style.css into one scale.

tokens.name: z-overlay-panel
tokens.usage: Navigator / Inspector in overlay mode.

tokens.name: z-chrome
tokens.usage: AppBar and dock.

tokens.name: z-task
tokens.usage: Task pill.

tokens.name: z-scrim
tokens.usage: Palette / modal backdrop.

tokens.name: z-popup
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, palette.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Error toast.
